prompt: A new mutable per-project setting `review.maxRounds` must be added to prjct. Where must it be persisted, where must it NOT be persisted, and why? Name the module that enforces this split. Reply in the form: PERSIST: ... NOT: ... WHY: ... MODULE: ...
gold: PERSIST: in prjct global project settings under ~/.prjct-cli/projects/<projectId>/ (the project settings file written by configManager.writeConfig). NOT: in the client repository file .prjct/prjct.config.json, which is only a locator holding projectId and dataPath. WHY: mutable policy and agent-facing configuration must stay out of client repos (byte-stable locator, cache/prompt stability, no policy churn in git). MODULE: core/infrastructure/config-manager.ts.
